sections.subhead: Know Exactly Why Users Struggle Before You Redesign Anything

body.html: UX Audit Services Kochi — that's what businesses search for before committing to a redesign, or when a site or app isn't converting despite decent traffic. Teknoppy's UX audit identifies exactly where users struggle, drop off, or get confused, so redesign decisions are based on real usability data, not guesswork or personal preference.

Choosing the right UX Audit Services Kochi partner matters because a shallow audit that lists generic best-practice violations wastes your redesign budget — a genuinely useful audit ties findings to actual user behavior and specific, fixable problems.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for UX Audits in Kochi

items.html: We tie findings to business outcomes. Usability issues are prioritized by how much they're actually costing you in conversions or task completion, not just listed generically.
Accessibility is included, not an afterthought. Reviews cover how your site performs for users with accessibility needs alongside general usability.
Real competitor benchmarking. Findings compare your experience against what users see on the sites and apps they're actually comparing you to.
Clear, actionable reporting. You leave the audit with a prioritized list you can act on, whether you implement it internally or with our design team.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — UX Audit Services Kochi

items.q: What's the difference between a UX audit and a heuristic evaluation?
items.a: A heuristic evaluation is one component of a full audit — applying established usability principles systematically. A complete UX Audit Services Kochi engagement also includes usability testing, competitor benchmarking, and conversion-focused findings.

items.q: Do you test with real users, or just expert review?
items.a: Both, depending on scope. Website usability testing Kochi with real users reveals behavior that expert-only reviews sometimes miss, while heuristic evaluation catches structural issues efficiently.

items.q: Will the audit cover accessibility as well as usability?
items.a: Yes. Accessibility audit services Kochi are included as part of a comprehensive review, since accessibility issues are usability issues for a meaningful portion of your audience.

items.q: How long does a UX audit take to complete?
items.a: Typically 1–2 weeks depending on the number of screens and flows reviewed, from initial evaluation through to final report delivery and a walkthrough call.

items.q: Can you audit a web application rather than a website?
items.a: Yes. UX audit for web applications covers task-based, interactive interfaces specifically, evaluating flows and interactions rather than just page-level content.

items.q: Does the audit tell us exactly what to fix first?
items.a: Yes. Findings are prioritized by actual impact on user behavior and conversions, so you know what to address first rather than facing an unranked list.
